title: A double-Lambda hypernucleus of boron-13 found with deep learning
summary: Neural networks selected images from the J-PARC E07 emulsion plates; microscopy and kinematic analysis then confirmed an event as a double-Lambda hypernucleus of boron-13. The discovery comes from analysis of 0.2% of the emulsions and is based on a single event; published in Nature Communications.

evidence.tested: Neural networks pre-selected candidate images from 0.2% of the J-PARC E07 emulsion data; microscopy and detailed kinematic analysis then confirmed one event as a boron-13 double-Lambda hypernucleus.
evidence.unknown: Only one event is confirmed; the estimate of more than 2,000 events in the full dataset is an extrapolation from the detection rate, and the article has no limitations section.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning networks trained to recognize double-strangeness signatures selected candidate images for microscopic examination.
